verdict.rationale: Jules exposes a documented API for creating custom workflows and automating tasks like bug fixing (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-10, jules-docs-12), which could be wired into a CI/CD pipeline to trigger a fix, and community evidence shows users building custom integrations to dispatch Jules tasks programmatically (jules-comm-19). However, there is no first-party CI/CD-specific integration (e.g. GitHub Actions step, build-failure webhook) or documented example of triggering Jules to fix a broken build/failing test directly from a pipeline. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration/example, evidence of triggering on build/test failure events, hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow succeeding.
